installer.language.title: Choose language
installer.language.description: The installer uses the selected language. Only this language is written to the USOS drive, for the boot menu and the helper programs. To change it later, run the installer again or update USOS.
installer.mode.checking: Checking whether a drive with USOS is connected...
installer.mode.no_source: Connect a drive and choose an operation. An existing USOS can be updated locally, repaired or uninstalled.
installer.mode.check_failed: Could not check for an installed USOS: %s
installer.mode.none_detected: No installed USOS detected. Installation will create a new drive.
installer.mode.detected_hidden.one: . This drive is hidden from reinstallation — use update, repair or uninstall.
installer.mode.detected_hidden.other: . These {count} drives are hidden from reinstallation — use update, repair or uninstall.
installer.mode.description: Choose an operation. Installation prepares a new drive, local update writes the current build without formatting, repair restores the ESP, and uninstall returns the drive to a single plain exFAT partition.
installer.mode.install.title: Installation
installer.mode.install.description: Creates ESP, DATA and WORK. All data on the selected drive will be deleted. Drives with a detected USOS are hidden here.
installer.mode.update.title: Local update
installer.mode.update.description: Writes the current USOS, completes the DATA structure and synchronizes the menu catalog with images, unattended files and icon.png. Does not format the drive or delete user data.
installer.mode.repair.title: Repair
installer.mode.repair.description: Detects an existing USOS and restores the files on the ESP. DATA and WORK stay unchanged.
installer.mode.uninstall.title: Uninstall
installer.mode.uninstall.description: Shows only correctly recognized USOS drives and returns them to a single exFAT partition.
installer.device.heading: Choose a drive for Universal Service OS
installer.device.description: Click a disk row to select it. Disks rejected by the safety policy stay visible and show the reason.
installer.device.found: Disks found: %d, meeting the installer policy: %d.
installer.device.hidden.one: USOS detected on 1 drive — it is hidden from installation. Use update, repair or uninstall.
installer.device.hidden.other: USOS detected on {count} drives — they are hidden from installation. Use update, repair or uninstall.
installer.device.pick_hint: Choose a disk from the list on the left to see details.
installer.reason.inspection_failed: the device could not be read safely: %s
installer.reason.system_disk: the disk contains the running Windows system
installer.reason.no_model: the device does not report the full model required for confirmation
installer.reason.no_serial: the device does not report the serial number required for revalidation
installer.reason.spanned_volume: the disk belongs to a volume spanning more than one disk
installer.reason.not_removable: the device does not report the RemovableMedia flag
installer.reason.too_small: the device is smaller than the required 32 GB
installer.installed.none: No installed USOS detected. Connect a USOS drive or go back and use installation.
installer.installed.found.one: USOS detected on 1 drive. Select it from the list to continue.
installer.installed.found.other: USOS detected on {count} drives. Select one from the list to continue.
installer.installed.row_state: USOS detected - ready for update / repair / uninstall
installer.installed.pick_hint: Choose a USOS drive from the list on the left to see details.
installer.update.select_title: Choose the USOS drive to update
installer.update.select_description: Local update writes the current USOS from this installer to the existing drive without formatting and without deleting system images.
installer.repair.select_title: Choose the USOS drive to repair
installer.repair.select_description: The list contains only drives with a detected USOS. Choose a drive to continue.
installer.uninstall.select_title: Choose the USOS drive to uninstall
installer.uninstall.select_description: The list contains only drives with a detected USOS. Plain USB drives without USOS do not appear in this list.
installer.confirm.title: WARNING - DESTRUCTIVE OPERATION
installer.confirm.warning: All partitions and all data on the selected drive will be permanently deleted. Once step 1/8 — clearing the partition table — starts, cancelling is no longer possible. Do not disconnect the drive or turn off the computer during the operation.
installer.confirm.no_volumes: No volumes are currently recognized — the partition table will be cleared anyway.
installer.confirm.volume:
%s
  file system: %s | capacity: %s | used: %s
  root directory: %s
installer.confirm.prompt: Required confirmation text — type it exactly, character for character:
installer.final.success_status: The final read of the drive matches the expected state of the operation.
installer.final.verify_failed_status: The drive did not pass the final verification. Do not treat it as correctly prepared.
installer.final.failed_status: The operation stopped before the final verification.
installer.install.progress_warning: The destructive operation has started. Cancelling is no longer available. Do not disconnect the drive or turn off the computer.
installer.update.title: Local update of Universal Service OS
installer.update.progress_warning: USOS files on the ESP and the program on DATA are being updated. System images, unattended files and other user data are not deleted.
installer.update.description: The update writes the current USOS files, completes the ready system folders and rebuilds the ESP menu catalog from the actual DATA contents. It does not format partitions, does not delete system images, unattended files or programs, and does not clear WORK.
installer.update.payload_unverified: The installer payload version cannot be confirmed: %s
installer.update.downgrade_warning: The drive has a newer version (%s), the installer has (%s) — downgrade?
installer.update.downgrade_confirm: I confirm downgrading the drive to an older USOS version.
installer.repair.title: Repair of Universal Service OS
installer.repair.description: Repair restores only the files on the ESP. DATA and WORK will not be formatted or cleared.
installer.repair.progress_warning: The ESP is being updated. DATA and WORK stay unchanged. Do not disconnect the drive while writing.
installer.uninstall.progress_warning: The destructive operation has started. Cancelling is no longer available. Do not disconnect the drive or turn off the computer.
installer.uninstall.confirm_warning: Uninstalling removes the whole USOS layout and creates a single plain exFAT partition. All DATA contents, including Systems, Utilities and Programs, will be gone. Once clearing the partition table starts, the operation cannot be cancelled or repaired automatically.
installer.uninstall.loss_esp: - ESP with the USOS boot manager
installer.uninstall.loss_data: - DATA with Systems, Utilities, Programs and all other contents
installer.uninstall.loss_work: - WORK with its working contents and .usos-work
installer.uninstall.prompt: To confirm, type the full device model exactly, character for character:
